title: 第9章 杀老猎人喝锻骨酒第10章 前往妖山射鸟妖
content_zh:
一声虎啸震得老猎人双耳瞬间失聪，脑袋更是昏沉不已。
一头吊睛白额大虫自黑暗中扑出，顷刻间便将那老猎人扑倒在地，张口便朝其脖子咬去。
突如其来的袭击，便是老猎人也慌了神，手中长矛第一时间脱手而出，只好以双手抓住身上老虎的脖子，使出全身力道向外推去，不敢令那张血盆大口真的落下。
“孽畜，老子我昔日也曾捕猎过你这样的大虫，岂会栽在你这畜生的口中？”
“给我滚！”
老猎人怒吼，声音响如洪钟，一点都不比那虎啸逊色。
大吼间也不知道他是哪儿来的力量，竟真的将二哈给掀翻了出去，接着一翻身便骑坐在二哈的身上，举拳便锤。
“打杀了你这头大虫，老子便再去寻那小畜生索命！”
老猎人气喘吁吁，目眦欲裂，满腔怒火都倾泻在了拳头上，一拳重过一拳，打得二哈惨叫连连。
“抱歉，恐怕你没有那个命了！”
突然一道冰冷的声音自老猎人身后响起，接着只闻一声“噗嗤”传出。
老猎人身体一颤，高举的右拳顿时垂落，他低头看向自己胸口，正好见到一截矛尖刺出。
这矛尖却是有几分眼熟，正是他用来捕猎野兽的器物之一。
老猎人至死都没想到自己打了一辈子猎最后竟会死在自己的长矛之下。
“一口一个畜生，一口一个牲口，那你们这些人又算是什么？”
“老子忍你很久了！”
莫凡在老猎人身后愤怒开口，接着张开血盆大口，显露出锋利如刀刃般的满口獠牙，一口便将老猎人的脑袋给生生咬掉！
“你也不过是爷爷我腹中之食而已，又能够尊贵到哪里去？！”
莫凡面露阴沉，嘴里不断咀嚼着，肉沫和鲜血于他齿缝间流淌了出来。
此时的他，真的像极了一只妖怪，一只真正吃人的妖怪！

这虽然是莫凡第一次杀人，但他却没有半点心理负担，因为此人该杀，也该死！
欲杀我者，我也可杀之！
这便是莫凡的理念，这一世他不再是人，自然也就没有了那么多的人伦道德约束，虽然看似野蛮残暴，但这何尝又不是一种自由？
老猎人的尸体莫凡也没留下，与二哈一起大餐了一顿。
然而吃完老猎人后，莫凡却是吐了好久。
他虽然顶着个妖怪的身体，可内里终究还是属于人的。
“妈的，第一次吃人还不太适应，等以后吃多了或许就适应了？”
莫凡自语，然后又冲着身边鼻青脸肿的二哈一顿拳打脚踢，喝骂道：“没用的东西，堂堂山林之王，差点被这老东西给打死，你说你有啥用？”
“吼唔——”
二哈不满地低吼了一声，旋即便将目光投向一旁的大白兔身上，不自觉地伸出舌头舔了舔嘴唇。
“想也别想，这是只妖，等级比你高，你也敢吃它？”
“何况它对我来说有大用，你要敢吃它，我就把你放锅里熬煮了！”
望着一脸凶巴巴的莫凡，二哈虽然眼馋那只大白兔，但终究不敢造次，重新趴在一旁无聊的打起盹来。
作为这方圆二十里地的王，二哈的生活总是这么朴实无华，大多数时间都沉溺在睡梦之中，只有饿了才会出去觅食。
不过自从莫凡来了后他偷懒的时间倒是少了大半，此时得空自然得抓紧时间休息。
莫凡也没去理会这家伙，开始清理自己的战利品。
一杆近丈长的精铁矛、一柄牛角大弓、数支羽箭。
content_en:
A tiger's roar shook the old hunter's ears instantly, and his head became even more dizzy.
A big, eye-catching white-fronted insect jumped out of the darkness. In an instant, it threw the old hunter to the ground and opened its mouth to bite his neck.
The sudden attack made even the old hunter panic. The spear in his hand was immediately released. He had to grab the tiger's neck with both hands and push it outward with all his strength, not daring to let the bloody mouth really fall.
"You evil beast, I have hunted a big insect like you in the past. How could I fall into the mouth of a beast like you?"
"Get out of here!"
The old hunter roared, the sound was as loud as a bell, no less than the tiger's roar.
While he was roaring, he didn't know where the strength came from, but he actually knocked Erha over. Then he turned over and sat on Erha's body, raising his fist to strike.
"After I kill this big bug like you, I will go look for that little beast again!"
The old hunter was panting, his eyes were splitting, and all his anger was poured into his fists. Each punch was harder than the last, making Erha scream in agony.
"Sorry, I'm afraid you don't have that life!"
Suddenly a cold voice sounded from behind the old hunter, and then there was only a "puff".
The old hunter's body trembled, and his raised right fist suddenly dropped. He looked down at his chest, just in time to see the tip of a spear thrust out.
The tip of this spear looked somewhat familiar, it was one of the tools he used to hunt wild beasts.
The old hunter never imagined that he would die under his own spear after hunting all his life.
“One mouthful is like a beast, one mouthful is like an animal, so who do you people count?”
"I've been putting up with you for a long time!"
Mo Fan spoke angrily behind the old hunter, then opened his bloody mouth, revealing a mouthful of fangs as sharp as blades, and bit off the old hunter's head in one bite!
"You are just food in my belly, grandpa, how can you be so noble?!"
Mo Fan had a gloomy look on his face, chewing continuously in his mouth, and meat foam and blood flowed out from between his teeth.
At this time, he really looked like a monster, a real man-eating monster!
Although this was Mo Fan's first time killing someone, he didn't have any psychological burden because this person deserved to be killed and deserved to die!
If you want to kill me, I can kill you too!
This is Mo Fan's philosophy. In this life, he is no longer a human being, so he naturally does not have so many moral constraints. Although it seems barbaric and cruel, is this not a kind of freedom?
Mo Fan didn't leave the old hunter's body behind either, and had a feast with Erha.
However, after eating the old hunter, Mo Fan vomited for a long time.
Although he has the body of a monster, he is still human inside.
"Damn, I'm not used to eating people for the first time. Maybe I'll get used to it if I eat more in the future?"
Mo Fan muttered to himself, then punched and kicked Erha, who was next to him with a bruised nose and face, and cursed: "You useless thing, the majestic king of the forest, I was almost beaten to death by this old guy, what do you think you are good for?"
"Hoo-"
Erha growled in dissatisfaction, and immediately turned his gaze to the white rabbit aside, unconsciously sticking out his tongue and licking his lips.
"Don't even think about it. This is a monster with a higher level than you. How dare you eat it?"
"Besides, it is of great use to me. If you dare to eat it, I will put you in a pot and boil it!"
Looking at Mo Fan with a fierce look on his face, Erha, although he coveted the big white rabbit, did not dare to make a mistake and lay aside again and took a nap in boredom.
As the king of a land with a radius of twenty miles, Erha always leads a simple and unpretentious life. He spends most of his time sleeping and only goes out to look for food when he is hungry.
However, since Mo Fan came, he has lost most of his time to be lazy. Now that he has free time, he naturally has to take the time to rest.
Mo Fan ignored this guy and started cleaning up his trophies.
A fine iron spear nearly ten feet long and a large ox-horn bow, several feather arrows.
